data.body: **[P1] Contain all non-fatal plugin errors.** This catches only `Exception` and `LinkageError`, so errors such as `AssertionError` or `ServiceConfigurationError` escape `onInvocationStart` and can fail the durable execution despite the documented isolation contract. The same gap exists in `run()` for hooks. Catch `Throwable`, rethrow only fatal errors such as `VirtualMachineError` and `ThreadDeath`, and add factory/hook regression tests using `AssertionError`.
